==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|good-by|goodby||dated}}
* {{alt|en|good-bye}}
* {{alt|en|good bye}}
* {{alt|en|g'bye||colloquial}}
* {{alt|en|bye|'bye||informal}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:from<conj:and>|God|be<id:is>|with<id:preposition>|you|:influence|good|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ǵʰew-}}
From earlier {{m|en|goodby}}, {{m|en|Godby}}, {{m|en|Godby'e}}, {{m|en|Godbwye}}, {{m|en|God b'w'y}}, {{m|en|God bwy yee}}, {{m|en|God buy you}}, {{m|en|God be wi' you}}, each a progressively shorter contraction of {{m|en||God be with ye}} or {{m|en|God be with you}}. Note the change of {{m|en|God}} to {{m|en|good}} by confusion with {{m|en|good morning}}, {{m|en|good night}}, etc. Modernly analysed as {{af|en|good|bye}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|go͝odbīʹ}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɡʊdˈbaɪ/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɡɵdˈbɑj/|a=SSB}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɡʊdˈbaɪ/|/ɡədˈbaɪ/|/ɡəˈbaɪ/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-goodbye.ogg|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɡʊdˈbɑe/|a=AU,NZ}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Pvanp7-goodbye.wav|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɡʉdˈbaɪ/|a=Scotland,NI}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪ|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|good|bye}}

===Interjection===
{{en-intj}}

# {{l|en|farewell|Farewell}}; a formula used to another person or persons when the speaker, writer, or person addressed is [[depart]]ing.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|formal}} {{l|en|[[adieu]] (literary)}}, {{l|en|farewell}}
* {{sense|informal}} {{l|en|bye}}, {{l|en|bye-bye}}, {{l|en|catch you later}}, {{l|en|mind how you go}}, {{l|en|see ya}}, {{l|en|see you}}, {{l|en|see you in the funny papers}} {{qualifier|US|informal|dated}}, {{l|en|so long}}, {{l|en|ta-ta}}, {{l|en|tatty bye}}, {{l|en|toodle-oo}}, {{l|en|toodles}}, {{l|en|TTFN}}, {{l|en|ttyl}}, {{l|en|tara}}

* {{l|en|adios}}, {{l|en|arrivederci}}, {{l|en|au revoir}}, {{l|en|do svidanya}}/{{l|en|do svidaniya}}, {{l|en|sayonara}}
* {{sense|UK|informal}} {{l|en|cheerio}}, {{l|en|cheers}}, {{l|en|cheery-bye}}, {{l|en|toodle-pip}} {{qualifier|dated}}
* ''See also:'' [[Thesaurus:goodbye]]
